import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
        int n = s.length();
        boolean atReplaced = false;
        int cur = 0;
        while (cur < n) {
            if (cur == 0) {
                res.append(s.charAt(cur));
                cur++;
                continue;
            }
            int nextAt = -1, nextDot = -1;
            // Search for "at" from cur to n-3
            for (int j = cur; j <= n - 3 && j + 1 < n; ++j) {
                if (!atReplaced && s.charAt(j) == 'a' && s.charAt(j + 1) == 't') {
                    nextAt = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
            // Search for "dot" from cur to n-4
            for (int j = cur; j <= n - 4 && j + 2 < n; ++j) {
                if (s.charAt(j) == 'd' && s.charAt(j + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(j + 2) == 't') {
                    nextDot = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
            int next = -1;
            boolean isAt = false;
            if (nextAt != -1 && (nextDot == -1 || nextAt < nextDot)) {
                next = nextAt;
                isAt = true;
            } else if (nextDot != -1) {
                next = nextDot;
                isAt = false;
            }
            if (next == -1) {
                res.append(s.substring(cur));
                break;
            }
            res.append(s, cur, next);
            if (isAt) {
                res.append('@');
                atReplaced = true;
                cur = next + 2;
            } else {
                res.append('.');
                cur = next + 3;
            }
        }
        System.out.print(res);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
